name: eur-lex-europa
description: EUR-Lex (eur-lex.europa.eu), the official portal for European Union law. This CLI searches EU legal documents by keyword with facet filters, sorting and paging, gets search suggestions, and fetches a document's text or metadata by CELEX number.
notes: EUR-Lex uses an AWS WAF bot challenge. During exploration, after many requests (especially the export dialog), every page started returning HTTP 202 with an empty #challenge-container body. If a command returns an empty title or text, the IP is being challenged: slow down and retry later.
The document detail pages (get-document-text, get-document-info) were never loaded successfully in the recording because the challenge blocked them, so their extract selectors are best-effort.
CELEX numbers are encoded as sector + year + type letter + number, e.g. 32016R0679 = sector 3 (legislation), 2016, Regulation, no. 679. Search result URLs contain them as uri=CELEX:<id>.

Other document URL patterns: PDF at /legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:<id>; language-auto page at /legal-content/AUTO/?uri=CELEX:<id>; replace EN with another language code (FR, DE, ...) for other languages.

Exporting results (export-documents.html, formats CSV/TSV/Excel/XML/PDF) was not recorded end to end because the submit was held, so no export command is provided. For bulk access, page through search-documents instead.
Search facet codes are the ones shown in EUR-Lex's filter sidebar. Combine several filters in one call, e.g. act_type=REG, year=2025, author=EP.
